(data source schema)
    description: Coralogix archive-metrics. Configures the S3/IBM bucket Coralogix archives metrics into. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/data-flow/s3-archive/connect-s3-archive/.
ibm  nested SINGLE computed
ibm.crn  tftypes.String computed
ibm.endpoint  tftypes.String computed
id  tftypes.String computed
prefix  tftypes.String computed
retention_policy  nested SINGLE computed
    description: The retention policy (in days) for the archived metrics. Having default values when not specified.
retention_policy.five_minutes_resolution  tftypes.Number computed
retention_policy.one_hour_resolution  tftypes.Number computed
retention_policy.raw_resolution  tftypes.Number computed
s3  nested SINGLE computed
s3.bucket  tftypes.String computed
    description: The bucket name to store the archived metrics in.
s3.region  tftypes.String computed
    description: The bucket region. see - https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/Concepts.RegionsAndAvailabilityZones.html#Concepts.RegionsAndAvailabilityZones.Regions
tenant_id  tftypes.Number computed
